# Antigravity Google AI Studio (`antigravity-aistudio`)

> **Supercharge Antigravity with Google AI Studio (v0.2.1 -- Pure Gemini 4 + Anti-Abuse Hardened Architecture):** Offload heavy reasoning, 1M-token document analysis, few-shot prompt engineering, URL context synthesis, and SDK code exports to **Gemini 4** cloud models (`Thinking level >= High`) with low-frequency high-density pacing, on-demand Search Grounding, and an `ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` zero-retry circuit breaker -- **preserving your local IDE model quota safely.** --- ## 1. Overview & Value Proposition ### The Problem: Local Desktop Quota Depletion When developing inside AI-first IDEs like Antigravity, desktop agent interactions consume metered, rate-limited local model quota (e.g., Gemini Neon, Gemini Hydrogen, Gemini Argon, Claude Opus). Performing long-context analysis (such as reading 500k-token repository documentation or massive log files), iterative few-shot prompt tuning, or deep multi-turn architectural brainstorming through the desktop agent quickly exhausts valuable daily quota allowances. ### The Solution: Cloud Agent Offloading (Gemini 4 + Thinking >= High) `antigravity-aistudio` v0.2.1 establishes an automated, anti-abuse hardened cloud offloading bridge to **Google AI Studio** ([aistudio.google.com](https://aistudio.google.com)): - **Pure Gemini 4 Cloud Roster**: Direct web access to `Gemini 4 Hydrogen`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `Gemini 4 Neon`, and `Gemini 4 Carbon` -- all unified with a `1,000,000` (`1M`) token context window. All pre-Gemini-4 models (`PaLM 2`, `Gemini 1.x`, `2.x`, `3.x`) are retired and blocked. - **Hard Thinking Level Floor (`>= High`)**: Every cloud offload enforces `Thinking level = High` in the Web UI (`"high"` or `"xhigh"` in SDK/API `thinking_level`). `Low` and `Medium` thinking levels are strictly prohibited, including explicit Medium-to-High overrides for `Argon` and `Carbon`. - **Desktop Quota Conservation**: Heavy reasoning, high-token reading, and exploratory iteration execute entirely in the cloud at zero desktop quota cost. - **Zero Local Daemons**: Driven via Antigravity's lightweight built-in `browser` subagent (`Model: "flash"`). No local Playwright server, Selenium drivers, or external MCP daemons are required. - **Seamless Local Sync**: Context and files are staged to the browser sandbox, processed in Google AI Studio with `Run settings` and `Tools` (`URL context`, `Structured outputs`, `Grounding with Google Search`, `Code execution`), and automatically synchronized back to your local codebase. ### Value Comparison | Dimension | Standard Desktop Execution | Cloud Offload with `antigravity-aistudio` v0.2.1 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Cloud Models** | Desktop metered allowances | **Pure Gemini 4** (`Hydrogen`, `Argon`, `Neon`, `Carbon`) | | **Context Window** | Limited by desktop model context | **Unified 1,000,000 Tokens** (`1M` in / up to `64K` out) | | **Thinking Floor** | Varies by local quota | **Enforced `Thinking level >= High`** (`Low`/`Medium` blocked) | | **Local IDE Quota** | Consumes metered daily allowances | **Zero Desktop Quota Consumed** (Cloud Offload) | | **External Dependencies** | Heavy local Playwright/Selenium daemons | **Zero Daemons** (Native Browser Subagent) | | **Workflow Automation** | Manual prompt copying & re-typing | **Automated 6-Stage Lifecycle Pipeline** | | **Safety & Boundaries** | Complex manual verification | **Fast-Path Auth, Paid Gate & Hard Safety Stops** | --- ## 2. Architecture & System Layers

`antigravity-aistudio` is structured across three core architectural layers: ``` antigravity-aistudio/ |-- plugin.json # Plugin manifest v0.2.1 conforming to agent-plugins schema |-- README.md # Comprehensive user & developer documentation |-- assets/ | |-- logo.svg # Official plugin vector logo | |-- hero-banner.png # Cinematic 16:9 hero banner | |-- architecture-offload-pipeline.png # High-density Gemini 4 offload pipeline diagram | |-- modular-skills-ecosystem.png # Modular 6-skill capability matrix diagram | |-- sponsor-wechat.png # WeChat Pay sponsorship QR | `-- sponsor-usdt.png # USDT (BSC) sponsorship QR |-- rules/ | `-- AGENTS.md # Always-on operating rules, Gemini 4 & Thinking >= High policy |-- skills/ | |-- aistudio-offload/ # Master offload orchestrator & decision router | | |-- SKILL.md | | `-- references/ | | `-- offload-decision-matrix.md | |-- aistudio-chat-prompt/ # Conversational prompts & system instructions | | `-- SKILL.md | |-- aistudio-structured-prompt/ # Tabular few-shot prompting & Structured outputs | | `-- SKILL.md | |-- aistudio-parameter-tuning/ # Gemini 4 Run settings, Thinking level >= High & Tools | | `-- SKILL.md | |-- aistudio-code-export/ # Production SDK code export (Python/TS/cURL/REST) | | `-- SKILL.md | `-- aistudio-ui-sync-audit/ # Read-only live UI drift & Gemini 4 sync audit | |-- SKILL.md | `-- references/ | `-- audit-checklist.md |-- scripts/ | `-- generate_infographics.py # High-resolution 2K infographic asset generator `-- tests/ # 5-Tier E2E automated test suite ``` ### System Architecture Flow ``` +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | LOCAL WORKSPACE | | | | [Developer Request] ---> [Offload Decision Engine] | | | | | +--------------------+--------------------+ | | | (Local Tasks) | (Cloud Offload Candidates)| | v v | | [Local Shell / Git] [Browser Staging Area] | | - Quick Start & Installation ### Installation from GitHub (Recommended) Install directly into Antigravity with one command: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/qq136692547-cmyk/antigravity-aistudio ``` ### Manual / Local Installation #### On Linux / macOS: ```bash git clone https://github.com/qq136692547-cmyk/antigravity-aistudio.git ln -s "$(pwd)/antigravity-aistudio" ~/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-aistudio ``` #### On Windows (PowerShell): > **Note:** On Windows, Antigravity's plugin scanner skips NTFS Junctions and symlinks. Clone or copy into a real directory under `$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\`: ```powershell # Clone directly into Antigravity's plugins directory git clone https://github.com/qq136692547-cmyk/antigravity-aistudio.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-aistudio" # Or copy an existing local clone Copy-Item -Path "$PWD\antigravity-aistudio" -Destination "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\antigravity-aistudio" -Recurse -Force ``` ### Manifest Validation Validate plugin syntax and directory structure locally: ```bash agy plugin validate . --strict ``` Once installed, manage or toggle the plugin on Antigravity's Customizations page. --- ## 4. Workload Offload Decision Framework & Gemini 4 Roster The plugin includes an intelligent decision engine that automatically classifies developer tasks into **Local Execution** or **Cloud Offload Candidates** targeting authorized **Gemini 4** models. ### Authorized Gemini 4 Cloud Model Roster (Unified 1M Context) | Model | API ID | Tier / Gate | Context / Max Output | Thinking Level Policy | Primary Workloads | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **`Gemini 4 Hydrogen`** | `gemini-4-hydrogen` | Free & Paid (Default) | 1M in / 64K (`65536`) out | `High` (`"high"` / `"xhigh"`) | Routine long text/logs (4K-1M), JSON schemas, synthetic data, daily prompt iteration | | **`Gemini 4 Argon`** | `gemini-4-argon` | Pro / Paid | 1M in / 32K (`32768`) out | **Switch Medium -> `High`** | Complex logic debugging, fine-grained engineering, knowledge problem solving | | **`Gemini 4 Neon`** | `gemini-4-neon` | Pro / Paid | 1M in / 64K (`65536`) out | `High` (`"high"` / `"xhigh"`) | Repo-wide architecture, complex software engineering, multimodal & 64K long outputs | | **`Gemini 4 Carbon`** | `gemini-4-carbon` | **Paid Gated** (Ultra / Paid API) | 1M in / 32K (`32768`) out | **Switch Medium -> `High`** | Extreme long-horizon reasoning, hardest math/science/architecture; fallback to Neon/Hydrogen if gated | > **Strict Floor & Pruning Policy**: `Low` and `Medium` thinking levels are prohibited for all cloud offloads. All pre-Gemini-4 models (`PaLM 2`, `Gemini 1.0`, `1.5`, `2.0`, `2.5`, `3.x`) are deprecated and rejected. ### Workload Partitioning Matrix | Workload Category | Execution Target | Criteria & Typical Operations | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Codebase Modifications** | **Local Machine** | File edits, multi-file refactoring, code formatting, patch application. | | **Git Operations** | **Local Machine** | `git status`, `git diff`, staging, branching, committing, pushing. | | **Test Execution** | **Local Machine** | Running `pytest`, `npm test`, `cargo test`, linters, and type checkers. | | **System Commands** | **Local Machine** | Terminal execution, build compilation, OS diagnostic scripts. | | **Quick Refactoring** | **Local Machine** | Local edits under 50 lines or trivial parameter renames. | | **Long-Context Analysis** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Analyzing multi-file logs, docs, or transcripts >= 4,000 tokens (up to 1M tokens) on `Gemini 4 Hydrogen` / `Neon (High)`. | | **Complex Debugging** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Deep root-cause isolation and fine-grained engineering on `Gemini 4 Argon (High)`. | | **Deep Reasoning & Design** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Architectural tradeoff analysis and extreme math/logic proofs on `Gemini 4 Neon` / `Carbon (High)`. | | **Few-Shot Prompt Engineering** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Calibrating system instructions, tabular input/output pairs, and few-shot examples. | | **Structured Output Testing** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Refining and validating complex JSON schemas via `Structured outputs` in chat or `/prompts/new_structured`. | | **Web Content Ingestion** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Reading live webpage bodies via `URL context` and `Grounding with Google Search`. | | **Model Comparison** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Evaluating prompts across `Gemini 4 Hydrogen`, `Argon`, `Neon`, and `Carbon` (`Thinking: High`). | | **Synthetic Data Generation** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Generating batch test fixtures, mock data, or synthetic corpora with `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`. | | **Production Code Export** | **Cloud (AI Studio)** | Converting tuned prompts into runnable Python, TypeScript, cURL, or REST code (`thinking_level: "high"`). | ### End-to-End Offload Pipeline Every cloud offload execution follows a strict 6-stage lifecycle: ``` [1. Evaluate] --> [2. Stage] --> [3. Dispatch] --> [4. Execute] --> [5. Extract] --> [6. Sync] ``` 1. **Evaluate**: Task is matched against the decision matrix in `offload-decision-matrix.md` and assigned an authorized Gemini 4 model. 2. **Stage**: Local context and files are copied to `/browser_sandbox/uploads/`. 3. **Dispatch**: The built-in `browser` subagent opens `https://aistudio.google.com/` directly. 4. **Execute**: Gemini 4 cloud models process prompts with `Thinking level = High` and configured `Run settings` / `Tools`. 5. **Extract**: Responses, schemas, and exported code are retrieved into `browser_sandbox/downloads/`. 6. **Synchronize**: Artifacts are validated and merged back into the local workspace. --- ## 5. Autonomy Modes `antigravity-aistudio` operates under two distinct autonomy modes: ### Checkpoint Mode (Default) In `checkpoint` mode, the agent prepares prompts, selects the Gemini 4 model (`Thinking level: High`), stages files, and formulates the offload plan, but **pauses and requests user approval** before submitting prompts or triggering exports in Google AI Studio. This gives developers complete oversight over prompt content and execution flow. ### Auto Mode (Full-Auto) In `auto` mode, the agent runs the offload lifecycle end-to-end without per-step confirmation: navigating the UI, enforcing `Thinking level = High`, configuring `Run settings` & `Tools`, submitting queries, extracting results, and writing files back to the workspace automatically. ### Triggering Auto Mode Mention unattended cues anywhere in your prompt: - `"auto mode"` / `"full-auto"` - `"run unattended"` - `"without asking for confirmation"` - `"batch offload to AI Studio"` You can switch modes at any point during a conversation by replying `"switch to auto mode"` or `"switch to checkpoint mode"`. ### Advanced: Low-Frequency High-Density Auto-Offload (Anti-Abuse Recommended) By default, `antigravity-aistudio` ships in conservative `checkpoint` mode and activates when you reference Google AI Studio or offload-eligible heavy workloads. Power users who want **automatic, zero-prompt-phrase cloud offloading** without triggering Google AI Studio's account-verification gate (`verify-account`) can add a paced Cloud-First routing rule to their global Antigravity rules file (`~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`): #### Preset A: Balanced High-Density Offload (Recommended -- Anti-Abuse Safe) Auto-offload heavy long-context analysis (`>= 4,000` tokens), deep architectural design, live URL research (`URL context`), multimodal asset analysis (`> 100 KB`), and batch synthetic data in `auto` mode using consolidated mega-prompts, while keeping short Q&A, small edits, and local coding on desktop: ```markdown ## Cloud-First Offload Policy (Balanced & Anti-Abuse Safe) - Automatically route heavy long-context docs/logs (>= 4,000 tokens), architectural tradeoffs, live web URL research, multimodal attachments, prompt/schema tuning, and synthetic data generation to `antigravity-aistudio` (Gemini 4, `Thinking level = High`) in `auto` mode -- consolidated into 1 mega-prompt per task. - Keep local code edits, Git, tests, shell commands, short Q&A, and minor reviews on desktop. - Anti-abuse pacing: enforce 15-30s randomized cooldown between cloud calls, soft cap of 5-8 calls/session, Hydrogen-first tiering, and keep `Grounding with Google Search` OFF for internal code/diff reviews (enable ON only for live web research). - Pause with zero retries on `ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` (`aistudio.google.com/verify-account`) and fall back gracefully to desktop; also pause on `LOGIN_REQUIRED`, `CAPTCHA_REQUIRED`, `Unlock Gemini 4 Carbon`, or `429` rate limits. - Bypass phrase: if I say "answer locally" or "skip AI Studio", reply directly on desktop. ``` #### Preset B: Maximum Quota Conservation (Paced Batch Offload + Local Fallback) Reserve desktop IDE model quota primarily for file edits, Git, tests, shell commands, and quick replies, and offload heavy non-mutating thinking, analysis, writing, research, and multimodal tasks in **consolidated mega-prompts** to Google AI Studio Gemini 4 (`Thinking level = High`) in `auto` mode: ```markdown ## Cloud-First Offload Policy (Paced Maximum Conservation) - Consolidate heavy non-local-mutation tasks (multi-file analysis, architecture planning, tradeoff comparison, long-form writing, web/URL research, multimodal inspection, prompt/JSON schema tuning, synthetic data) into a single high-density prompt routed to `antigravity-aistudio` in `auto` mode. - Cloud model routing (`Thinking level = High` floor, Hydrogen-first): - Routine analysis / writing / research / structured data -> `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)` - Precision debugging / nuanced tradeoffs -> `Gemini 4 Argon (High)` (explicitly switch from UI default `Medium` to `High`) - Repo-wide architecture / heavy multimodal / 64K long outputs / final audits -> `Gemini 4 Neon (High)` - Anti-abuse guardrails: reuse the active chat tab, enforce 15-30s randomized cooldown, cap at 5-8 calls/session, and keep `Grounding with Google Search` OFF unless live external web lookup is required. - Retain on desktop: file edits, Git operations, running tests/builds/shell commands, trivial Q&A (< 4,000 tokens), and automatic fallback whenever `ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` or `429` triggers. - Pause with zero retries on `ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` (`aistudio.google.com/verify-account`), `LOGIN_REQUIRED`, `CAPTCHA_REQUIRED`, `Unlock Gemini 4 Carbon` (fallback to Neon/Hydrogen High), or `429` rate limits. - Bypass phrase: if I say "answer locally" or "skip AI Studio", answer directly on desktop. ``` > **Tip**: Because global `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md` rules take precedence over individual plugin defaults, adding either preset enables seamless auto-offloading across all workspaces without modifying the plugin's safe default behavior for other users. ### 5.4 Production Pitfall & Root-Cause Fix: Preventing Agent "Short-Circuiting" (Local Laziness Trap) During production deployments with compound requests (e.g., *"Research topic X on the web and formulate a comprehensive architecture plan artifact"*), multi-agent supervisor systems often exhibit a subtle failure mode: **Local Laziness Short-Circuiting**: 1. **The Short-Circuiting Trap**: - Because the desktop supervisor agent possesses native search tools (e.g. `search_web`) and filesystem capabilities (`write_file`), it takes the path of least resistance: executing web queries and burning hundreds of thousands of deep-thinking tokens locally on expensive desktop quotas. - The agent falsely rationalizes: *"Because I will write a local artifact file at the end, this entire workflow counts as a local file modification."* - As a result, proactive offloading silently fails on compound tasks unless the user manually reminds the agent every single turn. 2. **The Two-Stage Decoupling Solution**: To permanently prevent this regression and ensure true hands-free autonomy, `antigravity-aistudio` enforces **Two-Stage Decoupling with Hard Negative Guardrails**: - **Stage 1 (Cloud Inference First)**: All background research, architectural evaluation, and drafting are strictly decoupled and dispatched to Google AI Studio via `invoke_subagent` (`TypeName: "browser"`). Local `search_web` calls or local deep CoT turns for research are strictly prohibited. - **Stage 2 (Local Materialization)**: Once Google AI Studio returns the synthesized output, the desktop agent acts solely as a light file-system receiver, saving artifacts locally with near-zero desktop token consumption. - **First-Action Gate**: For compound analysis/planning tasks, the supervisor's **very first tool call MUST be `invoke_subagent` (AI Studio)**. Performing local thinking or searching beforehand is classified as an offload violation. - **On-Demand Tools State Re-Verification Gate**: Because live Gemini 4 Web UI may initialize `Grounding with Google Search` to `ON`, explicitly inspect `Tools` and toggle Grounding **OFF** (`aria-checked="false"`) for internal code/diff reviews to reduce anti-abuse verification risk; when live web research IS required, re-inspect and toggle Grounding **ON** (`aria-checked="true"`) after any model switch or reload. Toggle `URL context` **ON** whenever explicit URLs are included. - **Anti-Abuse Pacing & Zero-Retry Verification Guard**: Enforce a 15-30s randomized cooldown and 5-8 calls/session cap; if `aistudio.google.com/verify-account` triggers, halt immediately with 0 retries and fall back to desktop. - **Visual Scrolling & Anti-Truncation**: Prohibit lazy `slice(0, 8000)` extraction; the subagent must execute real visual page scrolling (`page.mouse.wheel`) down the rendered stream and ingest full markdown/code outputs. To enforce this in Preset B, add the hardened clause into your `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`: ```markdown - **Anti-Short-Circuiting & Anti-Abuse Guardrails**: - Consolidate heavy research/architecture into 1 high-density mega-prompt; keep trivial Q&A local. - Never conflate "writing a local plan/artifact later" with performing heavy initial research/reasoning locally. - First tool call for heavy analysis/research tasks MUST be `invoke_subagent` (AI Studio) when cloud quota is healthy. - Keep `Grounding with Google Search` OFF for internal code/diff reviews; explicitly verify and enable it ON only for live web research. - Enforce 15-30s randomized pacing cooldown, 5-8 calls/session soft cap, and zero-retry local fallback on `ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED`. - Enforce real visual scrolling down the page to ensure complete, untruncated ingestion. ``` --- ## 6. Modular Skills Suite Overview

The plugin provides six dedicated skills covering the entire Google AI Studio Gemini 4 surface: | Skill | Purpose | Mode / Model Invocation | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **`aistudio-offload`** | Master cloud offload coordinator evaluating tasks against the Gemini 4 decision matrix and syncing results. | Standard | | **`aistudio-chat-prompt`** | Orchestrating multi-turn chat prompts, system instructions, `Thinking level = High`, `URL context`, and file attachments in `/prompts/new_chat`. | Standard | | **`aistudio-structured-prompt`** | Tabular few-shot prompting, input/output column configuration, and `Structured outputs` JSON schemas in `/prompts/new_structured`. | Standard | | **`aistudio-parameter-tuning`** | Configuring Gemini 4 `Run settings` (`Thinking level >= High`, `Output length`, `Media resolution`, `Safety settings`, `Add stop sequence`) and `Tools` (`URL context`, `Search Grounding`, `Code execution`, `Function calling`, `Structured outputs`). | Standard | | **`aistudio-code-export`** | Exporting production-ready client code (Python, TypeScript, cURL, REST) with `thinking_level` (`"high"`/`"xhigh"`) and `GEMINI_API_KEY` protection via `Get code`. | Standard | | **`aistudio-ui-sync-audit`** | Read-only live UI audit across 7 canonical AI Studio surfaces to detect UI drift, Gemini 4 model updates, or deprecations. | Manual (`disable-model-invocation: true`) | --- ## 7. Sandbox & Asset Staging Architecture Antigravity's `browser` subagent runs inside a sandboxed environment with strict filesystem boundaries: - **Upload Staging (`browser_sandbox/uploads/`)**: Any local files, datasets, or images meant for AI Studio prompt attachments are copied here with single-segment filenames before handing off to the browser subagent. - **Reference Inspection (`browser_sandbox/references/`)**: Visual assets and UI snapshots are stored here for multi-modal inspection. - **Download Retrieval (`browser_sandbox/downloads/`)**: Code snippets, exported JSON files, and prompt archives downloaded from AI Studio land here before being integrated into your project. --- ## 8. Security & Boundary Handling The plugin enforces strict safety stops and never compromises security: - **Account Verification Gate (`ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED`)**: Detects `"Your account must be verified"` / `https://aistudio.google.com/verify-account`, immediately aborts with **0 automated retries**, hands the verification link to the user, and falls back gracefully to local desktop execution. - **Anti-Abuse Velocity Pacing & On-Demand Grounding**: Enforces 15-30s randomized inter-request cooldowns, 5-8 calls/session soft caps, thread reuse, Hydrogen-first tiering, and keeps `Grounding with Google Search` OFF for internal code/diff reviews. - **Fast-Path Authentication**: Detects active signed-in sessions via avatar, recent prompts, and RPC signals without reading forbidden cookie stores. - **Google Sign-In Pause (`LOGIN_REQUIRED`)**: The agent never attempts to automate password entry or credentials. If logged out, it pauses and invites the user to sign in manually. - **CAPTCHA & Bot Detection (`CAPTCHA_REQUIRED`)**: Never attempts to bypass verification challenges; immediately hands control to the user. - **Paid Tier Gate (`Unlock Gemini 4 Carbon` / `PAID_TIER_REQUIRED`)**: If `Gemini 4 Carbon` triggers a paywall banner, immediately pauses and offers fallback to `Gemini 4 Neon (High)` or `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`. - **Rate Limits & Quota Exhaustion (`429 ResourceExhausted`)**: Catches quota barriers, reports them clearly, and offers model fallback (e.g., falling back to `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`). - **Safety Blocks (`HARM_CATEGORY_*`)**: Intercepts content safety blocks, reporting specific categories and enabling parameter or prompt adjustment. --- ## 9. Testing & Quality Assurance `antigravity-aistudio` includes a comprehensive 5-Tier automated test suite with adversarial hardening: ```bash python tests/run_tests.py ``` ### Verification Results ```text ================================================================================ ANTIGRAVITY-AISTUDIO 5-TIER E2E TEST SUITE RUNNER ================================================================================ Executing Tier 1 (Feature Coverage)......... PASS (98/98 passed) Executing Tier 2 (Boundary & Corner)........ PASS (99/99 passed) Executing Tier 3 (Cross-Feature & Pairwise). PASS (28/28 passed) Executing Tier 4 (Real-World Scenarios)..... PASS (8/8 passed) Executing Tier 5 (Adversarial Hardening).... PASS (33/33 passed) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- GRAND TOTAL: 266 / 266 PASSED (100% Pass Rate) ================================================================================ ``` --- ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=qq136692547-cmyk/antigravity-aistudio&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#qq136692547-cmyk/antigravity-aistudio&Date) --- ## More Open-Source Projects Explore the complete developer suite at the **[qq136692547-cmyk Open-Source Hub](https://qq136692547-cmyk.github.io/)** -- featuring all 12 projects across AI & Gemini plugins, local-first tools, AI Search (GEO), and commerce analytics. | Project | Category | Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **[magpie-gemini-media-tools](https://github.com/qq136692547-cmyk/magpie-gemini-media-tools)** | AI & Gemini Plugins | MCP tool plugin for Magpie exposing Nano Banana 2.1, Gemini Files API, and 3.8 TTS. | | **[QuickNote](https://github.com/qq136692547-cmyk/QuickNote)** | Local-First Tools | Blazing-fast offline-first AI scratchpad for developers with a 100% local SQLite vault. | | **[bookmark-health-master](https://github.com/qq136692547-cmyk/bookmark-health-master)** | Local-First Tools | 100% local-first Chrome MV3 extension with Dual-Stage DoH diagnostics and atomic undo. | | **[geo-score](https://github.com/qq136692547-cmyk/geo-score)** | AI Search (GEO) | Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) audit tool for measuring AI search visibility. | | **[anan-devtools](https://github.com/qq136692547-cmyk/anan-devtools)** | Local-First Tools | Free client-side developer utilities (UUID, Base64, JSON, JWT, hashes, regex, cron, and more). | --- ## Support & Buy Me a Coffee Building and maintaining open-source tools often happens deep into the night. Because the desktop supervisor agent possesses native search tools (e.g. `search_web`) and filesystem capabilities (`write_file`), it takes the path of least resistance: executing web queries and burning hundreds of thousands of deep-thinking tokens locally on expensive desktop quotas. - The agent falsely rationalizes: *"Because I will write a local artifact file at the end, this entire workflow counts as a local file modification."* - As a result, proactive offloading silently fails on compound tasks unless the user manually reminds the agent every single turn. 2. **The Two-Stage Decoupling Solution**: To permanently prevent this regression and ensure true hands-free autonomy, `antigravity-aistudio` enforces **Two-Stage Decoupling with Hard Negative Guardrails**: - **Stage 1 (Cloud Inference First)**: All background research, architectural evaluation, and drafting are strictly decoupled and dispatched to Google AI Studio via `invoke_subagent` (`TypeName: "browser"`). Local `search_web` calls or local deep CoT turns for research are strictly prohibited. - **Stage 2 (Local Materialization)**: Once Google AI Studio returns the synthesized output, the desktop agent acts solely as a light file-system receiver, saving artifacts locally with near-zero desktop token consumption. - **First-Action Gate**: For compound analysis/planning tasks, the supervisor's **very first tool call MUST be `invoke_subagent` (AI Studio)**. Performing local thinking or searching beforehand is classified as an offload violation. - **On-Demand Tools State Re-Verification Gate**: Because live Gemini 4 Web UI may initialize `Grounding with Google Search` to `ON`, explicitly inspect `Tools` and toggle Grounding **OFF** (`aria-checked="false"`) for internal code/diff reviews to reduce anti-abuse verification risk; when live web research IS required, re-inspect and toggle Grounding **ON** (`aria-checked="true"`) after any model switch or reload. Toggle `URL context` **ON** whenever explicit URLs are included. - **Anti-Abuse Pacing & Zero-Retry Verification Guard**: Enforce a 15-30s randomized cooldown and 5-8 calls/session cap; if `aistudio.google.com/verify-account` triggers, halt immediately with 0 retries and fall back to desktop. - **Visual Scrolling & Anti-Truncation**: Prohibit lazy `slice(0, 8000)` extraction; the subagent must execute real visual page scrolling (`page.mouse.wheel`) down the rendered stream and ingest full markdown/code outputs. To enforce this in Preset B, add the hardened clause into your `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`: ```markdown - **Anti-Short-Circuiting & Anti-Abuse Guardrails**: - Consolidate heavy research/architecture into 1 high-density mega-prompt; keep trivial Q&A local. - Never conflate "writing a local plan/artifact later" with performing heavy initial research/reasoning locally. - First tool call for heavy analysis/research tasks MUST be `invoke_subagent` (AI Studio) when cloud quota is healthy. - Keep `Grounding with Google Search` OFF for internal code/diff reviews; explicitly verify and enable it ON only for live web research. - Enforce 15-30s randomized pacing cooldown, 5-8 calls/session soft cap, and zero-retry local fallback on `ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED`. - Enforce real visual scrolling down the page to ensure complete, untruncated ingestion. ``` --- ## 6. Security & Boundary Handling The plugin enforces strict safety stops and never compromises security: - **Account Verification Gate (`ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED`)**: Detects `"Your account must be verified"` / `https://aistudio.google.com/verify-account`, immediately aborts with **0 automated retries**, hands the verification link to the user, and falls back gracefully to local desktop execution. - **Anti-Abuse Velocity Pacing & On-Demand Grounding**: Enforces 15-30s randomized inter-request cooldowns, 5-8 calls/session soft caps, thread reuse, Hydrogen-first tiering, and keeps `Grounding with Google Search` OFF for internal code/diff reviews. - **Fast-Path Authentication**: Detects active signed-in sessions via avatar, recent prompts, and RPC signals without reading forbidden cookie stores. - **Google Sign-In Pause (`LOGIN_REQUIRED`)**: The agent never attempts to automate password entry or credentials. If logged out, it pauses and invites the user to sign in manually. - **CAPTCHA & Bot Detection (`CAPTCHA_REQUIRED`)**: Never attempts to bypass verification challenges; immediately hands control to the user. - **Paid Tier Gate (`Unlock Gemini 4 Carbon` / `PAID_TIER_REQUIRED`)**: If `Gemini 4 Carbon` triggers a paywall banner, immediately pauses and offers fallback to `Gemini 4 Neon (High)` or `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`. - **Rate Limits & Quota Exhaustion (`429 ResourceExhausted`)**: Catches quota barriers, reports them clearly, and offers model fallback (e.g., falling back to `Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High)`). - **Safety Blocks (`HARM_CATEGORY_*`)**: Intercepts content safety blocks, reporting specific categories and enabling parameter or prompt adjustment. --- ## 9.
